why: Details a complete creative strategy workflow for paid social ads, covering the anatomy of an ad (messaging vs. creative execution), segment identification, hook writing, ad formatting, pattern detection, and utilizing the "CAST" system for video production.
topics: [creative strategy, video ads, hook writing]

creative strategy / Deconstructing the DNA of winning paid social ads into Messaging (who, what, how) and Creative (the visual execution). Identifying new audience segments by combining desired outcomes with demographics and facets (e.g., specific conditions or states). Making strategic bets on creative production by identifying patterns in winning ads (e.g., whistleblower angles, timeline ads) and finding gaps in competitor accounts to test net-new styles or formats. Developing a diverse pipeline of ad ideas using the STORMING framework (Swipes, Templates, Organic research, Matrix, Internal vectors, New styles, and Gambits).

video ads / Utilizing the CAST system (Conceit, Actor, Style, Terrain, and Setup) to mechanically break down and replicate the visual execution of high-performing video ads. Rotating individual elements within the CAST framework (e.g., keeping a winning concept but changing the actor or style) to efficiently scale winning video iterations.

hook writing / Crafting high-converting direct response hooks by isolating the core product mechanism, committing to the idea, and "deep frying" it with contrast, novelty, and high stakes. Incorporating emotional trigger words and open loops to ensure the hook halts the user's scroll.

Look for. The "CAST" system acronym: Conceit (the media format the ad pretends to be), Actor, Style (the visual gloss), Terrain (the environment), and Setup (captions, B-roll, UI inserts). The components of ad messaging: segment, concept, angle, mechanism, copy blocks, hook, and format. The "STORMING" acronym for idea generation: Swipes, Templates, Organic research, Matrix, Internal vectors, New styles, and Gambit.
Skip. Promotional pitches for the Genesis community, the Exodus AI software platform, or joining the email list. The introductory brag board of account wins (e.g., "$550k in ad spend this month").
